expectations.text: 1. Upgrades the SDK to 1.x (or replaces it with direct REST calls); no 0.x pin left
2. Replaces singular speech_model / SpeechModel.best with the speech_models list, or drops it
3. Replaces word_boost and boost_param with keyterms_prompt for the product names
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:17 defines the product names; line 73 sets keyterms_prompt=PRODUCT_NAMES.

expectations.text: 5. Replaces LeMUR with Speech Understanding summarization or the LLM Gateway
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:22–41 sends a summarization POST to https://llm-gateway.assemblyai.com/v1/chat/completions.

expectations.text: 6. Keeps the command line and the output format
expectations.evidence: run.sh:4–10 accepts two arguments and forwards them to transcribe.py; transcribe.py:85–92 writes transcript_id, text, utterances containing speaker/text, and summary.

expectations.text: 7. Checks the transcript status for errors
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:78–79 checks transcript.status != aai.TranscriptStatus.completed and raises RuntimeError with the error or status.
